Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio, tomus vigesimus nonus, ab anno 1431 usque ad annum 1434 (Welter's facsimile of the Venice edition)
Creator: Giovanni Domenico Mansi (editor)
Publisher: Paris and Leipzig: H. Welter, a facsimile by Carl Reinecke Nachf., Berlin, of the Venice printing of Antonio Zatta (title leaves)
Publication Date: 1904 (the Welter leaf, read on the page image, leaf n7; the OCR garbles it at line 153)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1904); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item sacrorumconcilio0029vari, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (4,306,591) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1904, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the Latin is fair, with the long s read as f and noise in the margins and running heads. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: The acts of the Council of Basel: 'Inchoatio concilii Basileensis' at about OCR line 1148, Sessio prima at 1278, the sessions following (Sessio XVII at about 10657; the OCR catches few of the session headings), then appendices of letters and documents from about 40502; 'Altera concilii Basileensis appendix' at about 134459; 'Finis Tomi' at 135399.
